battlebot:
BattleBot Extension for micro:bit
Provides blocks for controlling battle robots with motors, servos, sensors, and wireless controllers.
battlebot.Ultrasonic:
Measure the ultrasonic sensor distance in cm
500 means nothing detected
battlebot.calculateMotorSpeed: Calculate motor speed based on the stick position.
battlebot.disableServo: Turn off the servo so you can move it by hand.
battlebot.frontLed: Turn the front LED on or off.
battlebot.getButtonState: Check if the controller button is pressed right now.
battlebot.getStick: Get the stick position. left/reverse=-100, right/forward=100, 0=center.
battlebot.initLeds: Set up the (4) RGB LEDs. Use Neopixel to set colors
battlebot.moveServo: Move the servo to a position (0° to 180°).
battlebot.onButtonPress: Do something when the controller button is pressed or released.
battlebot.onLineSensor: Do something when the arena edge is detected.
battlebot.onVictory: Do something when your robot wins!
battlebot.readLineSensor: Check if the the robot is on the arena edge.
battlebot.servoPosition: Get the current position of the servo (0° to 180°).
battlebot.setMotorRawPower: Set motor power directly without conversion. For advanced users.
battlebot.setMotorSpeed: Set how fast the motor spins. Use negative numbers to go backwards.
battlebot.speedToPower: Convert speed to motor power for smooth movement. For advanced users.
battlebot.testVictory: Test your victory celebration without needing to actually win.
